body.statement: Theorem 1 of LacerdaSpirtesRamseyHoyer2008 states that the output of LiNG-D is an equivalence class under distribution entailment.

source.verbatim_statement: The output of LiNG-D is a set of SEMs that comprise a distribution-entailment equivalence class.
